chunks: And in the narration of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, he said: I asked him
about the muhrim removing a tick from the camel, so he said: “No, it is not like the louse from your body.”

key_terms.الْحَلَمَةَ: a tick or similar parasite found on an animal
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram remove a tick or parasite from a camel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in the state of ihram and the removal of a parasite from a camel. The Imam عليه السلام distinguishes between an external animal parasite and lice from one’s own body, indicating that they are not treated identically in the rulings of ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2721 - In the narration of Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, he said: I asked him

about a person in the state of ihram removing lice from a camel.
Imam (as) said: "No, it is like the lice from your own body."
